story_pairs: Only one {object} was left. Two friends reached for it together.
The friends took turns with the {object}. Each waited while the other had a turn.
A friend forgot a {object} at the gate. Kit saw it on the way home.
Kit brought the {object} back. The friend smiled and said thank you.
The {object} was too high for Pip to reach. Kit heard Pip call.
Kit asked a grown-up for help. Together they handed the {object} to Pip.
Kit wanted quiet time, but Pip wanted to play with the {object}.
Kit asked for a little space. Pip set the {object} aside until Kit was ready.
A gust blew the {object} under a bench. Neither friend could see it.
Pip looked from one side and Kit looked from the other. Together they spotted the {object}.
